claims.quote: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby
claims.statement: Great British Railways will have its home in Derby.

claims.quote: Great British Railways will bring the railway together around one mission - better services for passengers - with Derby at the heart of its future.
claims.statement: Derby will be at the heart of Great British Railways' future.

claims.quote: With 600 apprenticeships opening up, we’re investing not just in the railway of tomorrow
claims.statement: Up to 600 apprenticeships are opening up as an investment in the railway's future.

claims.quote: This forms part of our £2.5 billion youth employment support package which is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn
claims.statement: A £2.5 billion youth employment support package is creating up to 500,000 opportunities for young people to earn or learn.

claims.quote: I’m delighted that Great British Railways will be based here, bringing hundreds of jobs into the city.
claims.statement: Great British Railways will be based in Derby, bringing hundreds of jobs into the city.

claims.quote: Construction of the brand-new development in at Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre, is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.
claims.statement: Construction of the Becketwell headquarters is expected to begin in early 2027 and be completed by spring 2029.

claims.quote: new development to bring estimated £151 million boost to region and hundreds of rail jobs to the city
claims.statement: The new headquarters is estimated to bring a £151 million boost to the region's economy and hundreds of rail jobs to Derby.

claims.quote: The site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff
claims.statement: The headquarters site will accommodate up to 450 GBR staff.

claims.quote: be supported by better public transport links and walking routes, delivered in partnership with the Department for Transport, Derby City Council and the East Midlands Combined Authority.
claims.statement: Better public transport links and walking routes will support the site, delivered in partnership with the Department for Transport, Derby City Council and the East Midlands Combined Authority.

claims.quote: Up to 600 apprentices between 16 and 21 years old will enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship
claims.statement: Up to 600 apprentices aged 16 to 21 will enrol over the next 4 years on the rail foundation apprenticeship.

facts.quote: the site of Great British Railways’ (GBR) headquarters is unveiled today (15 October 2026) in Derby
facts.statement: The site of Great British Railways' headquarters was unveiled in Derby.

facts.quote: Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre
facts.statement: The headquarters site is Becketwell, a brownfield site in the heart of Derby city centre.

facts.quote: fares frozen for the first time in 30 years
facts.statement: Fares have been frozen for the first time in 30 years.

facts.quote: 76,000 extra seats a week introduced across the network
facts.statement: 76,000 extra seats a week have been introduced across the network.

facts.quote: the recent £1 billion investment in a new fleet of trains for the north set to be built at Alstom’s Derby site
facts.statement: A recent £1 billion investment was made in a new fleet of trains for the north, to be built at Alstom's Derby site.

facts.quote: less than 7% of the railway’s workforce is under 25
facts.statement: Less than 7% of the railway's workforce is under 25.
Andy Burnham, Prime Minister, made a statement on the railway.
Heidi Alexander, Transport Secretary, made a statement on the railway.

facts.quote: Work and Pensions Secretary Pat McFadden said:
facts.statement: Pat McFadden, Work and Pensions Secretary, made a statement on the railway apprenticeships.

facts.quote: Mayor of the East Midlands, Claire Ward, said:
facts.statement: Claire Ward, Mayor of the East Midlands, made a statement on the Derby announcement.
